搭配三类食材，提升均衡倍率: Mix all three for a balance bonus.
每把勺子独立备菜。圆环满了，勺子举起，再把菜抛出来。: Each ladle prepares its own scoop. A full ring means the ladle is about to toss.
新增触手按已营业档口轮流分配；同一档口出现多个圆环，就会有多把勺子同时备菜。: New tentacles rotate through open stalls. Several rings at one stall mean several ladles prepare food at once.
升级会扩充本档口的菜谱。每勺先预告一道菜，其余同勺食材随机抽取；圆环颜色变红时即: Upgrades add dishes to this stall. The ring previews the first dish; extra food in that scoop is random. A red ring means the toss is imminent.
